# Alexandr Chumak

> EU citizen, no sponsorship required for EU roles. Senior Frontend / Product Engineer with 6+ years building production web and mobile software in React, TypeScript and Next.js. Currently Lead Frontend Developer at Multisoft (Romania, remote). Open to senior frontend and product-engineering roles across the EU.

Sole frontend engineer on the Multisoft restaurant CRM: built the Next.js and TypeScript client from zero and owns its component system, routing structure and frontend conventions, across the order, menu and reporting modules — dense tables, filtering, validation and long forms over REST APIs. Five years before that at TeamArt on EVCARGO, a production e-mobility logistics platform: built and maintained the shared design system and component library, built the React Query and Axios data layer covering auth refresh, caching, pagination, filtering, invalidation and error handling, contributed to the React Native app and cross-platform releases including Android SDK upgrades and iOS release validation, introduced Playwright coverage for critical flows, and ran frontend code review. Built and deployed Rivella solo, a multi-tenant AI booking assistant running in production: a Next.js and TypeScript admin panel over a NestJS and Prisma API on PostgreSQL 16, a tenant-scoped data model with non-null tenant keys across all 12 tenant-scoped tables, one bot process per tenant behind per-slug webhook routing, an assistant that answers through a bounded tool-calling loop over 15 tools with PostgreSQL full-text search over each tenant's knowledge base, Telegram and YClients integrations for availability and bookings, five scheduled jobs, 138 API tests passing across 12 suites behind a 46-path OpenAPI spec, shipped as Docker images built in GitHub Actions and deployed to a VPS. Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, React Native, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zod. Based in Chișinău, UTC+2. Languages: Russian native, English B2, Romanian B2, Ukrainian B2.
